name: Women Scientist Scheme-A (WOS-A)
provider: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Govt. of India

rules.quote: Women Scientists Scheme-A (WOS-A) provides platform to women scientists and technologists for pursuing research in basic or applied sciences
(iii) M.Sc in Basic or Applied Sciences/B.Tech/MBBS or equivalent degree
for pursuing research in basic or applied sciences in frontier areas of science and engineering
The Scheme is open throughout the year.

amount.text: Rs 55,000/month (PhD group), Rs 40,000/month (M.Phil/M.Tech/M.Pharm/M.VSc group), Rs 30,000/month (M.Sc/B.Tech/MBBS group)
amount.quote: Rs.55,000/- per month for first eligibility group, Rs.40,000/- per month for second eligibility group and Rs.30,000/- per month for third eligibility group

deadline.quote: The Scheme is open throughout the year.
